channels.candidate_method: Calibrated load cell plus measured moment arm; tare sleeve/fixture
channels.required_resolution: Resolved change larger than combined force/arm uncertainty and declared minimum mechanical effect
channels.sampling_requirement: Full path and reversals; anti-alias against fastest observed transient
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: Compatible if fixture remains outside pressure envelope
channels.calibration_method: Deadweight or traceable load-cell calibration plus arm metrology
channels.fallback_method: Independent torque transducer if geometry permits
channels.expected_range: From tared fixture baseline to human-approved load-cell and wire-integrity limit; numeric bounds TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.measurement_function: Local curvature of active wire section
channels.candidate_method: Two-dimensional or stereo optical tracking of centerline/markers, corrected for camera calibration
channels.required_resolution: Uncertainty below the predeclared separation between regime boundaries
channels.sampling_requirement: Synchronized with load, pressure and mechanism channels; event onset timing resolvable
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: Conditional on optical access; otherwise outside sleeve shape tracking validated against local reference
channels.calibration_method: Calibration grid and known-radius reference plus unloaded shape
channels.main_confound: Actuator travel mistaken for specimen curvature; out-of-plane bending
channels.fallback_method: External bend-angle/shape sensor validated on pilot
channels.expected_range: From measured initial curvature to smallest approved wire, sleeve and fixture limit; numeric bounds TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.candidate_method: Calibrated transducer at cuff with line-loss/lag characterization
channels.required_resolution: Uncertainty below pressure change used to classify regimes; no conversion to f_n
channels.sampling_requirement: Sample fast enough to resolve regulator transients and align with mechanics
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: Requires certified fitting and leak-tested port
channels.calibration_method: Traceable pressure calibrator, zero and hysteresis check
channels.main_confound: Pressure at pump differs from active cuff; membrane load lag
channels.expected_range: From ambient differential baseline to certified cuff/fitting proof-limited pressure; numeric upper bound TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.measurement_function: Relative axial motion of two adjacent wire material points
channels.candidate_method: Preferred: paired colored fiducials on visible adjacent outer wires through verified transparent pressure path; track membrane and bundle reference simultaneously
channels.required_resolution: Relative displacement and onset exceed combined optical, registration, elastic-strain and clamp-motion uncertainty
channels.sampling_requirement: High enough to resolve onset and dwell; timestamps aligned with curvature
channels.physical_intrusion: Surface fiducials may alter friction; paired marked/unmarked control required
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: UNPROVEN until sealed window and marker perturbation tests pass
channels.calibration_method: Rigid-body and common-motion controls; imposed known relative shift; compare with exposed unpressurized reference
channels.main_confound: Differential elastic extension, marker debonding, membrane motion and whole-bundle drift
channels.fallback_method: Individually tracked wire tails plus calibrated axial-strain correction; if neither validated, no slip claim
channels.expected_range: From zero within registered noise to maximum relative displacement allowed before loss of contact or end travel; bounds TO_BE_MEASURED.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.measurement_function: Transformation-sensitive local state, not strain alone
channels.units: dimensionless proxy or calibrated strain/temperature/load combination
channels.candidate_method: Preferred: wire-local strain trajectory plus local thermal response and a batch-matched single-wire stress-strain/thermal signature under same rate/T; optional wire-specific four-terminal resistance only if interwire electrical shunting and lead effects are excluded
channels.required_resolution: Combined signature separable from friction-only, elastic NiTi and membrane/fixture controls beyond propagated uncertainty
channels.sampling_requirement: Synchronized during onset/reversal/dwell, sufficient to resolve fronts or plateau transitions if claimed
channels.physical_intrusion: Optical markers, thermal probe or electrical leads may perturb packing
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: UNPROVEN; lead feedthrough or optical/thermal path requires pressure and packing checks
channels.calibration_method: Single-wire cyclic calibration at pilot T/rate; elastic control; friction-only control; independent phase test if available
channels.main_confound: Friction heat and local strain concentration can imitate transformation; resistance affected by T, strain and wire-to-wire shorts
channels.fallback_method: Independent phase-sensitive assay on interrupted witness specimen, if available; otherwise classify as indirect and fail if controls cannot discriminate
channels.expected_range: Single-wire calibrated elastic-to-transformation signature span at tested temperature/rate; bounds TO_BE_MEASURED.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.measurement_function: Bundle-adjacent temperature, ambient temperature and actual local rate
channels.candidate_method: Wire-adjacent miniature thermometry or verified optical thermometry, ambient probe; derive local strain rate from synchronized strain field
channels.required_resolution: Temperature uncertainty mapped through measured d sigma_tr/dT to stress/strain uncertainty; rate uncertainty below declared slow/fast separation
channels.sampling_requirement: Capture transients and dwell relaxation; identical clock base
channels.physical_intrusion: Probe attachment may alter local contact; external imaging path may be blocked
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: Conditional; sleeve optical/IR transmission and feedthrough must be tested
channels.calibration_method: Reference thermometer, thermal step response, single-wire rate calibration
channels.main_confound: Sleeve temperature differs from wire; emissivity/transmission and sensor lag
channels.fallback_method: Thermocouple through rated feedthrough or validated thermal inverse bound
channels.expected_range: Ambient/baseline through highest permitted thermal excursion and slow-to-faster actual local rate; bounds TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN and TO_BE_MEASURED.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.measurement_function: Sleeve radial/hoop deformation and section shape
channels.candidate_method: Outer-surface optical markers or contour measurement at same section as mechanism channels
channels.required_resolution: Resolve shape changes large enough to shift the pressure-transfer/curvature interpretation
channels.sampling_requirement: Aligned at each pressure and curvature state
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: Conditional on visible outer layer and rated marking method
channels.calibration_method: Known-dimension target and pressure-only inflation control
channels.main_confound: Outer shape does not uniquely determine inner contact traction
channels.fallback_method: Section imaging/proxy plus independent inflation calibration
channels.expected_range: Unpressurized contour to certified safe inflation/deformation envelope; bounds TO_BE_MEASURED.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

channels.measurement_function: Clamp motion, end slip and fixture compliance
channels.candidate_method: Markers on each clamp and wire tail, fixture-only loading and sleeve-only controls
channels.required_resolution: Uncertainty below measured interwire relative motion and global curvature correction
channels.sealed_envelope_compatibility: Compatible if markers outside pressure zone
channels.calibration_method: Rigid dummy and known-compliance fixture calibration
channels.main_confound: Clamp creep or wire pull-through mimics slip
channels.expected_range: Rigid-dummy zero-drift baseline to predeclared allowable clamp motion; bounds TO_BE_MEASURED and TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN.
channels.sampling_frequency_Hz: TO_BE_SELECTED_BY_HUMAN after measuring sensor bandwidth, fastest onset/dwell, anti-alias requirement and clock synchronization.

s02_transformation_rule: Strain threshold alone is insufficient. Require concordant batch-matched single-wire calibrated thermomechanical signature and local specimen channels, surviving elastic and friction-only controls; report INDIRECT_SUPPORT unless a validated phase-sensitive measurement is available.
s02_slip_rule: Require relative wire material motion after rigid-body, membrane, clamp and elastic-extension correction; a global hysteresis loop or tail motion alone is insufficient.
